## Highlights

- Bundles `mobius` 0.7.5 and preserves Scratchpad's read-only management refresh when the capability
  is disabled for the agent.
- Keeps historical Scratchpad notes visible across agent recipe updates without restoring model
  tools, prompt instructions, or mutation authority.

## Upgrade

- Gateway protocol 24, checkpoint version 5, SQLite schema 5, configuration version 15, and chat
  specification version 7 are unchanged.
